title: What are your thoughts on the movie *Detachment*?**

commenti.body:
Performance-wise its incredibly powerful, and I think Adrien Brody gives some of the best work of his career probably. He plays deep seated overwhelming loneliness and sadness so well. The cinematography is interesting too, it kind of has a peeping tom quality to it sometimes, like we're just peering in.

On the same hand though, I cant help but feel a little annoyed with the direction. It just feels like Tonk Kaye wanted to make some sadness porn, its unrelenting to a point that it gets a little cheesy, or at least that's how i felt when I watched it.
